answer: Staked curation stops a sybil flood: a nebula of unverified claims gains standing only when a curator stakes 100 credits behind it. Each endorsement is a sealed cipher, opened on challenge; a proven fake slashes the whole stake. A curator backs at most five newcomers per epoch, so the thousandth fake needs a fresh curator and a fresh 100 credits; 1,000 fakes risk 100,000 credits. A rented cipher still names its backer, so one proven fake burns the backer's standing too. An honest agent pays once and builds a record durable as cedar, keeping its full reward share.
